title: Prawn Noodles with Nam Jim Sauce
description: A quick Thai-style stir-fry of king prawns and pre-cooked noodles tossed with a tangy fish sauce, tamarind and chilli nam jim dressing.
ingredients: large handful of coriander (~20g), finely chopped
juice of 1 lime (plus lime wedges to serve)
3 spring onions, cut diagonally into 5mm slices
2 red chillies, deseeded and finely chopped
steps: Mix prawns with garlic, a pinch of salt and olive oil; set aside.
Make sauce: mix shallot, fish sauce, tamarind paste, chilli flakes, maple syrup, half the coriander and lime juice.
Set a sauté pan or wok over medium-high heat; add prawns; stir-fry 1½ minutes until pink.
Loosen noodles; add to pan with sauce; stir to coat noodles.
Add spring onions, chillies, basil and remaining coriander; stir-fry ~1 minute.
Scatter sesame seeds over top; serve with lime wedges.
notes: If ancho chilli flakes are hard to find, use chipotle or another smoky chilli.
source: The Slimming Foodie by Pip Payne (2021)
